meta.note: Batch three toward 1000: school and language words, the health counter, roads and tolls, landlord vocabulary, clothing for a mountain island, the abstract nouns (saudade, jeito, pena) that carry real conversation, degree adverbs and a round of everyday verbs.

cards.ex_t: Tenho aula de português às terças.
cards.ex_trans: I have Portuguese class on Tuesdays.

cards.ex_t: O exame A2 tem uma parte oral.
cards.ex_trans: The A2 exam has an oral part.

cards.ex_t: Aprende-se mais com os erros.
cards.ex_trans: You learn more from mistakes.

cards.note: fazer uma pergunta — questions are made, not asked
cards.ex_t: Posso fazer uma pergunta parva?
cards.ex_trans: Can I ask a silly question?

cards.ex_t: A resposta certa era a terceira.
cards.ex_trans: The right answer was the third one.

cards.ex_t: Qual é o significado desta palavra?
cards.ex_trans: What's the meaning of this word?

cards.ex_t: A tradução literal não ajuda aqui.
cards.ex_trans: The literal translation doesn't help here.

cards.note: o sotaque madeirense — its own music
cards.ex_t: O teu sotaque está cada vez melhor.
cards.ex_trans: Your accent keeps getting better.

cards.ex_t: Ainda não percebo as piadas na televisão.
cards.ex_trans: I still don't get the jokes on TV.

cards.ex_t: Cá o costume é jantar tarde? Nem por isso.
cards.ex_trans: Is the custom here to dine late? Not really.

cards.ex_t: Sem receita médica não vendemos este.
cards.ex_trans: Without a prescription we can't sell this one.

cards.ex_t: A vacina da gripe é gratuita para residentes.
cards.ex_trans: The flu vaccine is free for residents.

cards.ex_t: Tenho de fazer análises em jejum.
cards.ex_trans: I have to do blood tests on an empty stomach.

cards.note: as urgências — where the night goes to die
cards.ex_t: Esperámos cinco horas nas urgências.
cards.ex_trans: We waited five hours in A&E.

cards.ex_t: Tens um penso? Cortei-me no papel.
cards.ex_trans: Got a plaster? I cut myself on paper.

cards.ex_t: Esta tosse não me larga há duas semanas.
cards.ex_trans: This cough hasn't let go of me for two weeks.

cards.note: the false friend supreme — NOT constipation
cards.ex_t: Apanhei uma constipação na levada.
cards.ex_trans: I caught a cold on the levada.

cards.ex_t: Magoei-me no joelho a correr.
cards.ex_trans: I hurt my knee running.

cards.ex_t: A autoestrada da Madeira é um túnel atrás do outro.
cards.ex_trans: Madeira's motorway is one tunnel after another.

cards.ex_t: Depois do túnel, primeira saída.
cards.ex_trans: After the tunnel, first exit.

cards.note: directions are counted in rotundas here
cards.ex_t: Na segunda rotunda, sai à direita.
cards.ex_trans: At the second roundabout, exit right.

cards.ex_t: Esta estrada tem portagens?
cards.ex_trans: Does this road have tolls?

cards.ex_t: O estacionamento do centro está sempre cheio.
cards.ex_trans: The downtown car park is always full.

cards.ex_t: Apanhei uma multa por estacionar mal.
cards.ex_trans: I got a fine for bad parking.

cards.ex_t: Há uma gasolineira antes da subida.
cards.ex_trans: There's a petrol station before the climb.

cards.ex_t: Vira à esquerda no semáforo.
cards.ex_trans: Turn left at the traffic light.

cards.note: Madeira's roads are made of them
cards.ex_t: Cuidado, esta estrada tem curvas apertadas.
cards.ex_trans: Careful, this road has tight bends.

cards.ex_t: A subida para o Monte é a pé só para corajosos.
cards.ex_trans: The climb to Monte on foot is for the brave.

cards.ex_t: O inquilino anterior deixou a casa impecável.
cards.ex_trans: The previous tenant left the place immaculate.

cards.note: the gas one on the wall — a Portuguese institution
cards.ex_t: O esquentador desliga-se sozinho, é da pilha.
cards.ex_trans: The heater turns itself off — it's the battery.

cards.note: casas portuguesas e o aquecimento — uma tragédia
cards.ex_t: A casa não tem aquecimento, só um aquecedor.
cards.ex_trans: The house has no heating, just a space heater.

cards.ex_t: Há humidade na parede do quarto.
cards.ex_trans: There's damp on the bedroom wall.

cards.ex_t: O canalizador só pode vir para a semana.
cards.ex_trans: The plumber can only come next week.

cards.ex_t: O eletricista trocou o quadro todo.
cards.ex_trans: The electrician replaced the whole fuse box.

cards.note: partido is for things that snap; avariado for machines
cards.ex_t: A máquina de lavar está avariada.
cards.ex_trans: The washing machine is broken.

cards.trans: to fix; to get hold of
cards.ex_t: Consegues arranjar-me isso até sexta?
cards.ex_trans: Can you get that for me by Friday?

cards.note: terno is Brazilian; fato de banho — swimsuit
cards.ex_t: Só uso fato em casamentos.
cards.ex_trans: I only wear a suit at weddings.

cards.ex_t: Esqueci-me do fato de banho, claro.
cards.ex_trans: I forgot my swimsuit, of course.

cards.ex_t: Para a levada leva sapatilhas com bom piso.
cards.ex_trans: For the levada take trainers with good grip.

cards.ex_t: Sem chapéu não vás ao Pico do Areeiro.
cards.ex_trans: Don't go to Pico do Areeiro without a hat.

cards.ex_t: No planalto até um cachecol faz jeito.
cards.ex_trans: On the plateau even a scarf comes in handy.

cards.ex_t: Luvas na Madeira? Só na serra, em janeiro.
cards.ex_trans: Gloves on Madeira? Only in the mountains, in January.

cards.ex_t: Tenho o telemóvel no bolso do casaco.
cards.ex_trans: My phone's in my jacket pocket.

cards.ex_t: A mochila leva água, casaco e bolo do caco.
cards.ex_trans: The backpack carries water, a jacket and bolo do caco.

cards.ex_t: Veste algo quente, vamos para a serra.
cards.ex_trans: Put on something warm, we're going to the mountains.

cards.ex_t: Experimenta a poncha de tangerina.
cards.ex_trans: Try the tangerine poncha.

cards.ex_t: Foi uma boa escolha vir para cá.
cards.ex_trans: Coming here was a good choice.

cards.ex_t: Tens razão, desculpa.
cards.ex_trans: You're right, sorry.

cards.note: na minha opinião — hedge like a local
cards.ex_t: Na minha opinião, o norte é mais bonito.
cards.ex_trans: In my opinion, the north is prettier.

cards.ex_t: Tivemos sorte com o tempo.
cards.ex_trans: We were lucky with the weather.

cards.ex_t: Que azar, logo hoje que há greve.
cards.ex_trans: What bad luck — a strike, today of all days.

cards.note: THE Portuguese word; tenho saudades tuas
cards.ex_t: Já tenho saudades do verão.
cards.ex_trans: I already miss summer.

cards.note: fazer jeito — to come in handy; ter jeito — to be good at
cards.ex_t: Não tenho jeito nenhum para desenhar.
cards.ex_trans: I have no knack for drawing at all.

cards.note: estar à vontade — make yourself at home
cards.ex_t: Não tenho vontade nenhuma de sair hoje.
cards.ex_trans: I have zero desire to go out today.

cards.ex_t: Cuidado com o degrau à saída.
cards.ex_trans: Mind the step on the way out.

cards.note: paciência… — also 'oh well' with a sigh
cards.ex_t: Com a burocracia é preciso paciência.
cards.ex_trans: With bureaucracy you need patience.

cards.note: que pena! — what a shame; vale a pena — worth it
cards.ex_t: Que pena não teres vindo ontem!
cards.ex_trans: What a shame you didn't come yesterday!

cards.note: bocadinho — the pt-PT diminutive of bocado
cards.ex_t: Só um bocadinho de arroz, obrigado.
cards.ex_trans: Just a little rice, thanks.

cards.note: the answer to 'tudo bem?' on a Monday
cards.ex_t: — Como vai isso? — Mais ou menos.
cards.ex_trans: — How's it going? — So-so.

cards.ex_t: Pelo menos não choveu.
cards.ex_trans: At least it didn't rain.

cards.ex_t: Há cada vez mais turistas no Funchal.
cards.ex_trans: There are more and more tourists in Funchal.

cards.ex_t: De repente o nevoeiro cobriu tudo.
cards.ex_trans: Suddenly the fog covered everything.

cards.ex_t: Não consigo ouvir e escrever ao mesmo tempo.
cards.ex_trans: I can't listen and write at the same time.

cards.ex_t: Em vez de autocarro, vamos a pé?
cards.ex_trans: Instead of the bus, shall we walk?

cards.ex_t: O voo atrasou por causa do vento.
cards.ex_trans: The flight was delayed because of the wind.

cards.ex_t: O casal do terceiro teve um bebé.
cards.ex_trans: The couple on the third floor had a baby.

cards.ex_t: O bebé dorme finalmente a noite toda.
cards.ex_trans: The baby finally sleeps through the night.

cards.note: the pt-PT word — moleque/garoto are Brazilian
cards.ex_t: Os miúdos jogam à bola no largo.
cards.ex_trans: The kids play football in the square.

cards.ex_t: Há desconto para idosos no teleférico.
cards.ex_trans: There's a senior discount on the cable car.

cards.ex_t: Quantos convidados vêm ao jantar?
cards.ex_trans: How many guests are coming to dinner?

cards.ex_t: A minha prima vem passar o Natal cá.
cards.ex_trans: My cousin is coming to spend Christmas here.

cards.ex_t: Os sogros chegam sábado. Calma.
cards.ex_trans: The in-laws arrive Saturday. Stay calm.

cards.note: de baixo — downstairs; the eternal saga
cards.ex_t: O vizinho de cima decidiu aprender bateria.
cards.ex_trans: The upstairs neighbour decided to learn drums.

cards.ex_t: Emprestas-me o guarda-chuva até logo?
cards.ex_trans: Will you lend me the umbrella till later?

cards.ex_t: Devolvo-te o livro para a semana.
cards.ex_trans: I'll give the book back next week.

cards.ex_t: Prometo não me atrasar desta vez.
cards.ex_trans: I promise not to be late this time.

cards.ex_t: Convidámos os vizinhos para um jantar.
cards.ex_trans: We invited the neighbours over for dinner.

cards.note: two kisses, or a handshake — read the room
cards.ex_t: Cá cumprimenta-se toda a gente na rua.
cards.ex_trans: Here you greet everyone in the street.

cards.ex_t: Queria agradecer a vossa ajuda.
cards.ex_trans: I'd like to thank you for your help.

cards.ex_t: Não desistas, o pior já passou.
cards.ex_trans: Don't give up, the worst is over.

cards.ex_t: O comboio? Não há. O autocarro demora uma hora.
cards.ex_trans: The train? There isn't one. The bus takes an hour.

cards.ex_t: Combinamos para as sete, então?
cards.ex_trans: Seven o'clock then, agreed?
